title: Completeness of seeded matrix verification
statement: Let an input specify a positive output dimension and bias parameters satisfying the stated positivity and ratio constraints. For any three square matrices over the two-element field of that dimension, if the third matrix is the product of the first two, then the seeded matrix-product verification procedure accepts with probability one.
hypotheses_covered: A small-bias input, with positive output dimension and numerator and twice the numerator at most the denominator
Three square matrices over the two-element field, indexed by the input's output dimension
The third matrix equals the product of the first two
